title: FBI-UAP-D013, Washington State ‘UFO’ Investigation, 1952-1960
what_is_it: A collection of memoranda and correspondence between the FBI and the U.S. Air Force regarding UFO sightings investigated in Washington State from 1952 to 1960.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text is available — the document is a scanned image with no OCR output, so all facts are derived from metadata only.
Without readable text, the extent of redactions within the document cannot be assessed.
Details of specific sightings, witness identities, and investigation conclusions are unknown from metadata alone.

verifiable_claims.claim: The FBI investigated various UFO sightings in Washington State between July 1952 and August 1960.
